name: Shire Intelligence
long_description:
Shire is building the operating system for self-driving restaurants.

Shire connects to restaurants' existing cameras to understand what's happening in real time. It sees what a great manager sees: guests ready to order, tables waiting to be cleared, and servers getting overwhelmed. Then it acts, directing staff, balancing workloads, and optimizing seating.

Shire is also the POS, combining payments and real-time restaurant operations with AI agents that handle the work managers do behind the scenes: scheduling staff, managing inventory, ordering supplies and analyzing each shift to improve the next.

Our goal is to automate everything in a restaurant except hospitality.
